description: This file defines a React component TopKeyView responsible for displaying top keys with options for tabular and chart views, as well as fetching and displaying detailed key info in a modal. It includes UI elements, state management, external API calls, and data transformations.

methods.name: toggleTagsExpansion
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state for tags of a specific API key, updating the expandedTags state set.

methods.name: handleKeyClick
methods.description: Fetches detailed key info via API call, transforms it, and opens a modal with the data.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal and resets key data and selection.

methods.name: handleOutsideClick
methods.description: Handles clicks outside the modal to close it.
